basis: Ketogenesis defect; hepatic steatosis 4/5 and transaminase elevation 13/16 support liver injury. Lasting neurologic damage is not established in ≥30%.

decisions.neurologic: none: encephalopathy (9/10) and seizures (13/14) occur during metabolic crises; patients are usually asymptomatic between episodes, without established common lasting brain injury.

basis: IgG4-related retroperitoneal fibroinflammation; ureteric encasement causes obstructive urinary dysfunction in roughly half or more. Other fibrotic sites vary.

decisions.renal: involved: the retroperitoneal fibrosis parent supports direct ureteric encasement and obstruction, occurring in approximately 50% or more.

basis: Named limb-heart-cleft triad defines syndrome; lung hypoplasia 80-99%. Cap omits ear canal atresia and parathyroid anomalies (80-99%) and renal anomalies (30-79%).

decisions.pulmonary: involved: lung hypoplasia occurs in 80-99%; retained for severity, with the three primary slots assigned to the named limb-heart-cleft triad.
decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: cleft lip and palate are defining malformations in the syndrome's name and definition; cleft palate occurs in 80-99%.

basis: Arterial stenosis, skeletal fragility/malformations and learning or intellectual impairment define syndrome. Renal artery disease is vascular; renal damage is not established.

decisions.neurologic: primary: learning difficulties or borderline intellectual disability are explicitly defining features and occur in 80-99%.

basis: Rare skin/nail dystrophy with characteristic congenital sensorineural deafness; hearing loss is treated as part of the defining phenotype, although frequencies are unavailable.

decisions.otologic: primary: congenital sensorineural deafness is characteristic of this rare neurotrophica phenotype alongside skin atrophy and nail dystrophy.

basis: Tympanic membrane inflammation defines the disease. The umbrella includes noninfectious forms; inflammation alone does not establish an infectious or immune-mediated mechanism.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: the definition establishes inflammation, without establishing infection, autoimmunity or another immune-mediated disease across the umbrella.

basis: Inherited autonomic failure with defining orthostatic hypotension; types 1 and 2 are inborn catecholamine synthesis disorders.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: the included types 1 and 2 involve defective norepinephrine biosynthesis through dopamine beta-hydroxylase deficiency or its CYB561-dependent support.

basis: Sterol storage with defining CNS/tendon disease; cataracts impair vision in 80-99%; osteoporosis occurs in 30-79%. Diarrhea alone does not establish gut damage.

decisions.ocular: involved: cataracts and visual impairment occur in 80-99%; the three primary slots retain the metabolic mechanism and named cerebral and tendon sites.
decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: tendon xanthomata are a defining, named site; osteoporosis in 30-79% additionally establishes common skeletal damage.

basis: Adrenal hyperplasia causes autonomous aldosterone secretion; moderate to severe hypertension is explicitly defining and occurs in 100%.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: moderate to severe hypertension is part of the disease's own definition and is annotated as obligate (100%).

basis: Defining cervical skin webbing, intellectual disability and digital skeletal anomalies; persistent eyelid ptosis occurs in 30-79%.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: pterygium colli is an obligate congenital skin web and a named defining feature; primary structural malformations do not require acquired skin injury.
